title: Elysium: Simulation-Free Unbalanced Schr\"odinger Bridges
abstract: arXiv:2611.24763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing cellular dynamics from snapshots is challenging because the destructive nature of single-cell measurements makes tracking the same cells over time impossible. Cellular dynamics are inherently stochastic and involve changes in population size through proliferation and apoptosis. Growth-based methods represent population change as a rate on the density, which does not assign exits and entries to individual cells. Unbalanced Schr\"odinger bridges model individual events, but neural solvers for killed diffusion bridges simulate trajectories during training. We introduce Elysium, a simulation-free solver that jointly learns state transition and mass change. Using a killed Brownian reference and its time reversal, Elysium constructs direct regression objectives from an optimal endpoint coupling and conditional bridge distributions, without simulating trajectories during training. translated_title: Elysium：免仿真的非平衡薛定谔桥
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.24763v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：从快照数据重建细胞动力学是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为单细胞测量的破坏性使得无法随时间追踪同一批细胞。细胞动力学本质上是随机的过程，并且由于增殖与凋亡而涉及种群规模的变化。基于生长的方法将种群变化表示为密度上的增长率，这种方式无法将个体的退出和进入分配到具体细胞。非平衡薛定谔桥能够对个体层面的事件进行建模，但现有针对被终止扩散桥的神经求解器需要在训练过程中模拟轨迹。我们提出了 Elysium，一种免仿真的求解器，能够联合学习状态转移与质量变化。利用被终止的布朗运动参考过程及其时间反演，Elysium 从最优端点耦合和条件桥分布出发构建了直接的回归目标，而无需在训练期间模拟轨迹。我们证明了期望轨迹极……
tldr: Elysium 提出了一种免仿真的非平衡薛定谔桥求解方法，联合学习状态转移与质量变化，无需在训练中模拟轨迹即可从快照数据重建随机细胞动力学。
en_tdlr: Elysium is a simulation-free unbalanced Schrödinger bridge solver that jointly learns state transitions and mass changes, reconstructing stochastic cellular dynamics from snapshots without simulating trajectories during training.
